title: Code and data for: From the Kapitza pendulum to Hill's equation: parametric stability under non-sinusoidal drive, and why the Mandar dancing-horse rider stays upright

creators.name: Agung, Afiq
creators.affiliation: Universitas Sulawesi Barat, Majene, West Sulawesi, Indonesia

description: Python scripts and derived data for an article on the parametric stability of the rider in the Mandar sayyang pattuqduq (dancing horse) tradition: Floquet maps for the Mathieu and Hill equations, tongue-threshold and square-wave checks, video measurement of rider head motion with synthetic-motion injection tests, and rebana tempo analysis. The analysed YouTube videos are not redistributed.
